derived_observation_definitions.name: funding_payment
derived_observation_definitions.expr: perp_position.notional * (max(funding_config.total_oi_long, funding_config.total_oi_short) - min(funding_config.total_oi_long, funding_config.total_oi_short)) / max(funding_config.total_oi_long + funding_config.total_oi_short, 1)

simulation_boundaries: Generic adapters expose only adapter-defined actions/observations; no default TVL/health semantics are inferred.
Pool-wide TVL/utilization metrics are zeroed on the generic path until a protocol-specific aggregate is declared.
Custom actions do not mutate engine cash/PnL by default; only on-chain account observations are authoritative.
